ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a complementary output stage circuit; the upper output transistor is connected to the +12 V power rail, and the lower output transistor is connected to the -12 V power rail; the outputs of the two transistors converge at the output node on the right. The output node is connected through a load resistor labeled 8 Ω to ground, and the output voltage uo is labeled across the load. Reasoning: The problem requires ignoring U_CES, so the maximum undistorted positive and negative half-cycle peak values of the output voltage can approximately reach the power rail voltage, that is, the maximum sinusoidal output peak value U_om = 12 V. The average power of the sine wave on the load is P_max = U_om^2/(2R_L). Substituting R_L = 8 Ω gives P_max = 12^2/(2×8) = 144/16 = 9 W.

raw_record.question_text: For the circuit shown in the figure, the maximum undistorted output power, ignoring \( U_{CES} \), is ______ W.

method.method_draft: From the image, note the output node drives an 8 Ω load to ground and the output transistors are powered by ±12 V rails. Since the question says to ignore U_CES, take the maximum undistorted output voltage swing as a sine wave with peak value 12 V. Convert to power in the load: P_max = U_om^2/(2R_L) = 12^2/(2×8) = 144/16 = 9 W.

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct supply-swing method: reads the rail voltages and load resistance from the image, then uses the sinusoidal load-power relation. This is the natural single route for this circuit; other variants would mostly be algebraic rearrangements, so this is only method needed.
planner_metadata.image_role: Identify the circuit as a complementary push-pull/emitter-follower output stage with split supplies marked +12 V and -12 V. Read the load resistor value as 8 Ω connected from the output node u_o to ground, with output polarity indicated across the load.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested quantity is maximum undistorted output power and that U_CES should be ignored; the answer must be reported in watts.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For a class-B/AB complementary output stage with symmetric ±V_CC rails, the largest undistorted sine output has peak amplitude approximately V_CC when transistor saturation voltage U_CES is ignored. The average power in a resistive load for a sine wave is P = V_peak^2/(2R_L) = V_rms^2/R_L.
